description: The same medication named by brand in one note and by generic name in another; both literal names must be preserved rather than merged into one canonical name.
input_notes: Cardiology note: Continue Lipitor 40 mg oral nightly for hyperlipidemia.
Pharmacy dispensing record: Filled atorvastatin 40 mg tablets, oral, once nightly, 30-day supply.

possible_inconsistencies: The cardiology note refers to Lipitor and the pharmacy record refers to atorvastatin; these are the same medication under its brand and generic names respectively, both at 40 mg nightly.
